body: OTF Jam is making headlines after throwing shade at LilDurk on his birthday, and the timing has people talking. The former OTF affiliate took to his Instagram story with a movie clip & caption that read, “The nation of Lil Durk’s,” sparking speculation about who the message was directed at and what he meant by it. Is Jam attention seeking ? chicago.
